long_biography.plain_text:
Antonio García Peralta entered the family footwear platform built by his father, Vicente García Torres, around Tempe and its partnership with Inditex. As director general and later chief executive, he became the operating face of the company, advocating international production and supply choices based on competitiveness, proximity to stores and logistics. Tempe designs, develops and distributes footwear and accessories for Inditex brands from its Elche base.

His responsibilities later broadened into the García Peralta investment network. García Peralta holds a minority interest in family holding Promociones Azarbe and represents it in property-investment companies, including the board of Inbest Prime VIII. He also owns a direct stake in that company. These roles combine experience in global footwear operations with governance of a diversified family portfolio spanning commercial real estate and other investments.
